projects.flagshipProject: Apex Freight Capital in-house software: AI email triage, AI command center, document RAG, self-hosted coding models
projects.description: Apex Freight Capital is the freight brokerage Sean founded in 2024 and runs: it serves shippers, manufacturers and commercial carriers, specializing in steel, oversized equipment and infrastructure loads that need flatbed, step-deck and RGN trailers, permits and escort planning, priced against carrier quotes, lane history, equipment limits and margin, with a network of 63 approved carriers that Sean vets himself against FMCSA operating authority, insurance certificates and safety records (a business process, not one of the software projects below). Sean is the company's founder and its lead software engineer: instead of buying a brokerage platform the company builds its own internal software in Python, TypeScript and Docker, with a small in-house engineering team of a few engineers that Sean leads, architects for and codes alongside, reviewing their pull requests and owning releases. The in-house systems: the AI Gmail Manager (Python, scikit-learn, SQLite) that classifies freight, quote and carrier email, learns priorities from starred messages and answers questions about the inbox, cutting daily triage from about 90 minutes to 25; AI Jarvis 2.0, the company's AI command center, with agent routing, task queues, a human approval step before anything reaches a customer or carrier, provider switching across OpenAI, Anthropic and DeepSeek, a relational store, usage and cost tracking, health monitoring, Whisper speech-to-text and remote Linux access over SSH; a containerized RAG API (FastAPI, ChromaDB, Ollama) with persistent vector storage, Swagger/ReDoc docs and GitHub Actions CI/CD that answers questions over company documents (rate confirmations, carrier packets, permit rules, operating procedures); Mozart R2D2, DeepSeek-Coder 1.3B Instruct self-hosted on rented Vast.ai GPUs behind FastAPI and Gradio as a private coding assistant, with a Docker image and idempotent bootstrap that rebuild a destroyed instance in under 5 minutes; Mozart Dueling AI, a Python/Tkinter tool that reviews the company's own code before release by sending it to GPT-4 and DeepSeek and scoring both reviews on 11 criteria (correctness, security, error handling, test coverage); Python lead research that normalizes government award records and resolves recipients to companies by entity matching, keeping the source behind every signal, to find infrastructure projects that will need heavy freight (sales leads, unrelated to carrier vetting); Truckers Chat, a communication app for carriers and freight professionals; a text-to-video avatar generator for the company's marketing videos, running the 19B-parameter LTX-2 model in FP8 on Vast.ai H100 80GB instances with a FastAPI backend, Streamlit UI, IC-LoRA face training and a setup script restoring about 40 GB of weights per fresh instance; and a Stripe Checkout and webhook payment prototype deployed on Vercel. Side projects in the same period: Vibe Coding Live, a Next.js/React/TypeScript live-streaming platform with Supabase auth, Postgres and storage, LiveKit WebRTC screen sharing and automatic recording that prunes the oldest files under a 5 GB cap; and Wolfpack Recall, built at the Cognee hackathon, a FastAPI/Docker service on Render that keeps evidence in Cognee graph memory and answers through Anthropic Claude. Scale is a small company's: the users are the company's staff, brokers and partners, load is measured in emails a day, loads and quotes a week, carriers, documents indexed and GPU instances, never in millions of users or enterprise traffic. The engineering team is small (a few engineers, not dozens), so team claims stay at that size: Sean leads the team, sets the architecture, reviews code and mentors, but there is no large organization, headcount budget or enterprise cloud estate; Mozart gives every change an automated second review. It touches the front end (Next.js, React, Streamlit, Gradio), the back end (FastAPI, Node.js, REST APIs, PostgreSQL, SQLite), AI/ML (LLM APIs, RAG, self-hosted models, scikit-learn classification) and infrastructure (Docker, Linux, GPU instances, CI/CD, Render, Vercel).
